mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ifj_runtime_command ( request_id, instance_id, root_instance_id, trigger_id, command_type, status, requested_by, available_at, expires_at ) SELECT #{requestId}, instance_record.id, instance_record.root_instance_id, instance_record.trigger_id, #{commandType}, 'PENDING', #{requestedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{timeoutMicros}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) FROM ifj_instance instance_record WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.trigger_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_instance instance_record ON instance_record.id = command_record.instance_id SET command_record.status = 'SUCCEEDED', command_record.result_message = 'Requested state is already satisfied', command_record.processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), command_record.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE command_record.request_id = #{requestId} AND command_record.status = 'PENDING' AND ((command_record.command_type = 'STOP' AND instance_record.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'SKIPPED')) OR (command_record.command_type = 'PAUSE' AND instance_record.status = 'PAUSED') OR (command_record.command_type = 'RESUME' AND instance_record.status = 'RUNNING'))

UPDATE ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_instance instance_record ON instance_record.id = command_record.instance_id SET command_record.status = 'REJECTED', command_record.result_message = 'Command is not valid for the current instance state', command_record.processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), command_record.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE command_record.request_id = #{requestId} AND command_record.status = 'PENDING' AND ((command_record.command_type = 'PAUSE' AND instance_record.status <> 'RUNNING') OR (command_record.command_type = 'RESUME' AND instance_record.status <> 'PAUSED') OR (command_record.command_type = 'RETRY' AND ( instance_record.status NOT IN ('FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') OR instance_record.parent_instance_id IS NOT NULL OR instance_record.id <> instance_record.root_instance_id)))

UPDATE ifj_trigger trigger_record JOIN ifj_runtime_command command_record ON command_record.trigger_id = trigger_record.id JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id SET trigger_record.status = 'RUNNING', trigger_record.message = NULL, trigger_record.error_code = NULL, trigger_record.message_key = NULL, trigger_record.message_args = NULL, trigger_record.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE command_record.request_id = #{requestId} AND command_record.status = 'PENDING' AND command_record.command_type = 'RETRY' AND trigger_record.status IN ('FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') AND work_item.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'DEAD')

UPDATE ifj_trigger_work_item work_item JOIN ifj_runtime_command command_record ON command_record.trigger_id = work_item.trigger_id SET work_item.status = 'READY', work_item.available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), work_item.lease_owner = NULL, work_item.claim_token = NULL, work_item.lease_deadline = NULL, work_item.attempt_count = CASE WHEN command_record.command_type = 'RETRY' THEN 0 ELSE work_item.attempt_count END, work_item.last_error = NULL, work_item.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE command_record.request_id = #{requestId} AND command_record.status = 'PENDING' AND ((command_record.command_type = 'RETRY' AND work_item.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'DEAD')) OR (command_record.command_type = 'STOP' AND work_item.status = 'SUSPENDED'))
mapper.select: SELECT command_record.request_id FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE command_record.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND command_record.available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND command_record.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> #{fenceToken})) AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND work_item.lease_deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT command_record.request_id AS requestId, command_record.trigger_id AS triggerId, work_item.fence_token AS fenceToken FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE work_item.lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.lease_deadline > strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AND command_record.available_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AND command_record.expires_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> work_item.fence_token)) ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT command_record.request_id AS requestId, command_record.trigger_id AS triggerId, work_item.fence_token AS fenceToken FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE work_item.lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.lease_deadline > CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND command_record.available_at <= CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND command_record.expires_at > CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> work_item.fence_token)) ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) command_record.request_id AS requestId, command_record.trigger_id AS triggerId, work_item.fence_token AS fenceToken FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE work_item.lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.lease_deadline > SYSUTCDATETIME() AND command_record.available_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() AND command_record.expires_at > SYSUTCDATETIME() AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> work_item.fence_token)) ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id

SELECT command_record.request_id FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE command_record.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND command_record.available_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AND command_record.expires_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> #{fenceToken})) AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND work_item.lease_deadline > strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT command_record.request_id FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE command_record.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND command_record.available_at <= CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND command_record.expires_at > CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> #{fenceToken})) AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND work_item.lease_deadline > CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AND ROWNUM <= #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) command_record.request_id FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK) JOIN ifj_trigger_work_item work_item ON work_item.trigger_id = command_record.trigger_id WHERE command_record.trigger_id = #{triggerId} AND command_record.available_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() AND command_record.expires_at > SYSUTCDATETIME() AND (command_record.status = 'PENDING' OR (command_record.status = 'PROCESSING' AND command_record.processing_fence <> #{fenceToken})) AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND work_item.lease_deadline > SYSUTCDATETIME() ORDER BY command_record.create_time, command_record.request_id

UPDATE ifj_runtime_command command_record JOIN ( SELECT request_id FROM ifj_runtime_command WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY expires_at, request_id LIMIT #{limit} ) expired ON expired.request_id = command_record.request_id SET command_record.status = 'EXPIRED', command_record.result_message = 'Command processing deadline elapsed', command_record.processing_owner = NULL, command_record.processing_token = NULL, command_record.processing_fence = NULL, command_record.processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), command_record.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE ifj_runtime_command SET status = 'EXPIRED', result_message = 'Command processing deadline elapsed', processing_owner = NULL, processing_token = NULL, processing_fence = NULL, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ifj_runtime_command ( request_id, instance_id, root_instance_id, trigger_id, command_type, status, requested_by, available_at, expires_at ) SELECT #{requestId}, instance_record.id, instance_record.root_instance_id, instance_record.trigger_id, #{commandType}, 'PENDING', #{requestedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) + (#{timeoutMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')) FROM ifj_instance instance_record WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.trigger_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO ifj_runtime_command ( request_id, instance_id, root_instance_id, trigger_id, command_type, status, requested_by, available_at, expires_at ) SELECT #{requestId}, instance_record.id, instance_record.root_instance_id, instance_record.trigger_id, #{commandType}, 'PENDING', #{requestedBy}, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now', printf('+%.6f seconds', (#{timeoutMicros} / 1000000.0))) FROM ifj_instance instance_record WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.trigger_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING

MERGE INTO ifj_runtime_command target USING ( SELECT #{requestId} AS request_id, instance_record.id AS instance_id, instance_record.root_instance_id AS root_instance_id, instance_record.trigger_id AS trigger_id, #{commandType} AS command_type, #{requestedBy} AS requested_by, CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS available_at, CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{timeoutMicros} / 1000000, 'SECOND') AS expires_at FROM ifj_instance instance_record WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.trigger_id IS NOT NULL ) source ON (target.request_id = source.request_id) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( request_id, instance_id, root_instance_id, trigger_id, command_type, status, requested_by, available_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( source.request_id, source.instance_id, source.root_instance_id, source.trigger_id, source.command_type, 'PENDING', source.requested_by, source.available_at, source.expires_at )
